settings.title: Great for parties!
settings.text: The food was great! If you’re looking for pinoy food to serve in your party, Nanay is a great choice. Hindi ka mapapahiya sa bisita. Our visitors loved it! Everything tastes good. They delivered the food in time and the food was packaged very nicely. Highly recommended 👍

settings.text: I ordered the fiesta feast and added an extra tray of skewers for my birthday party. All the guests said the food was amazing and I agreed!
